draft.subject: Getting Pioneer Group's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Following up on the notification badge ticket — I've shared an update by email, so do let me know if you're still seeing the badge count stick around; I'll keep it open until you confirm.

Since our welcome call, I wanted to check in on setup too. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help get that first project shaped?

Best,
Nadia
